purpose: Preview-only Smart Farm option C concept boards
base:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a production-quality visual design proposal board for the EXISTING Vietnamese Android app Smart Farm. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: strictly match its cream backgrounds, dark cocoa headings, forest/teal primary buttons, mint, peach, lavender and sky-blue accents, rounded white cards, gentle shadows and cute clean thick-outline sticker COW, PIG and GOAT illustrations. Preserve this cohesive exact design language across all new screens. Do not reproduce the entire reference board or its original two screens unless specified.
Composition: ONE high-resolution LANDSCAPE contact board with FOUR tall full-length Android smartphone screens in a SINGLE horizontal row. All four equally sized, large, perfectly straight-on, same scale, thin minimal dark phone frames, very small gutters and neutral warm-white backdrop. Fill the canvas; target 3072x2048 or equivalent high detail so Vietnamese labels are readable. Small understated group heading across top. Under each phone include its screen number and short title. Each viewport represents a realistic 412x880 Android layout, reasonable text size and touch targets. No tilted phones, photographic props, watermark or gratuitous decorations. Every UI label uses Vietnamese with accurate diacritics, clean rounded sans-serif. Keep phone status bars consistent at 9:41. Use only modest animal sticker embellishments, keep text and forms usable. Maintain same cute cow/pig/goat identities as reference. Root screens have exactly FIVE bottom nav destinations: "Tổng quan", "Chuồng trại", "Vật nuôi", "Lịch", "Thêm". Top-level Kho, Thu chi, Nhân sự, Danh mục, Tài khoản are reached from Thêm. Authentication screens have no bottom navigation. Fullscreen form/detail pages have a back arrow and no bottom navigation, sticky save/action button clear of Android system gesture area. Detail pages use unobtrusive overflow menu for rare operations.
Do not invent AI, QR, notifications, offline sync, social login, biometric login, export, payment, transfer payments, IoT, animal diagnosis automation or gamification. These concepts restyle existing functionality only. ADMIN can all; STAFF operate animals, weights, transfers, observe health and plan care but cannot complete care, sell animals, change catalogs or manage staff. VET can observe health, examine and complete care but cannot operate inventory or finances. ACCOUNTANT manages manual finances and views reports but cannot sell animals. Show controls appropriate to indicated role. Main sample farm "Trang trại An Nhiên". Cow animal "BO-001" nickname "Bông", breed "Holstein", female, pen A1, active, normal. Pig "HEO-012" pen B1 needs care. Goat "DE-006" pen C1. Pens A1 8/10, B1 12/15, C1 6/8, A2 10/12. Total herd 36. Date "23/10/2026" (omit weekday). Cards must have consistent units and sensible numeric data. Primary green buttons, muted outlined secondary buttons, amber needs-care, red reserved for destructive operations. Avoid clipping, overlapping text, decorative random text and illegible dense paragraphs. Show a natural first viewport and scrolling affordance for long forms rather than tiny squeezed fields. The four required screens and board title follow:
